ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: In the image, multiple vertical interfaces can be seen dividing the medium into different regions, and the region on the left is labeled Region I; the adjacent region to its right is labeled Region IV. The incident ray travels obliquely upward to the right in Region I and reaches the vertical interface, where a horizontal dashed line is drawn as the normal, and the angle θ is marked between the incident ray and this horizontal normal. According to the specified method, take the refractive index of Region I as n_I = n0, and the refractive index of Region IV as n_IV = n0/8. The beam “just does not enter Region IV” corresponds to the critical case: the refracted ray entering Region IV grazes along the interface, so the angle of refraction is 90°. At the Region I–Region IV interface, use Snell’s law: n0 sin θ = (n0/8) sin 90°. Since sin 90° = 1, sin θ = 1/8, hence θ = sin^{-1}(1/8).

The refractive indices in Regions I, II, III, and IV are $n_0$, $\frac{n_0}{2}$, $\frac{n_0}{6}$, and $\frac{n_0}{8}$, respectively. method.method_draft: First read the diagram: Region I is the left slab, Region IV is immediately to its right across a vertical interface, and the dashed horizontal line at that interface is the normal; the incident angle θ is drawn between the incoming ray in Region I and this normal. From the text, use n_I = n0 and n_IV = n0/8. Since the beam 'just misses entering Region IV,' treat the refraction into Region IV as the limiting grazing case, so the refracted angle is 90° with respect to the normal. Apply Snell's law at the Region I–Region IV interface: n0 sin θ = (n0/8) sin 90°. Therefore sin θ = 1/8 and θ = sin^{-1}(1/8).

按指定方法，取 Region I 的折射率为 n_I = n0，Region IV 的折射率为 n_IV = n0/8。光束“刚好不进入 Region IV”对应临界情况：进入 Region IV 的折射光线沿界面掠射，因此折射角为 90°。在 Region I–Region IV 界面用斯涅尔定律：n0 sin θ = (n0/8) sin 90°。因为 sin 90° = 1，所以 sin θ = 1/8，故 θ = sin^{-1}(1/8)。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a planar vertical boundary between Region I and Region IV, with the incident ray in Region I making angle θ to the horizontal normal. The other labeled regions to the right are not needed because the limiting event is failure to enter Region IV at the first boundary. From the text, n_I = n0 and n_IV = n0/8. Use conservation of the tangential component of the wave vector at a flat interface: k_I sin θ = k_IV sin φ, where φ is the angle the transmitted wave would make with the normal. At the threshold of no propagation into Region IV, the transmitted wave is grazing along the interface, so sin φ = 1. Since k is proportional to refractive index, n0 sin θ = n0/8, giving θ = sin^{-1}(1/8).
